exposure: Author has read previous business audit and four modular ranking tests. This is preregistered synthetic scenario validation, not a blind human holdout or a calibrated hiring study.
eligibility: Own demo pool; visible, matching consent, exact specialization, confirmed category at least requested grade, all verified requirements. Explicit per-skill minimum requires modular proof. All gates refer to one whole CV.

relevance.2: admissible with unresolved tax basis or format compromise

limits: No CV text/job semantic embedding is measured.
No human outcomes; small mirrored two-specialization corpus.
FSP is a category-local tie signal, never replaces missing skills/category.
Historical grade-only proof may be admitted, with less complete evidence.
Allowed selected IDs judge business context, not every formally eligible alternative.

metrics.precision: positives in top k divided by k including missing places
metrics.nDCG: DCG / ideal DCG over all labeled people; null if ideal=0
metrics.coverage: all false/missing admissions and selected CV errors, no excluded failed cases
